Diff longitudinal flags

diff_flags.Rd

Compares old and new flag tables and classifies records as introduced, resolved, or persisting.

Usage

diff_flags(old_flags, new_flags, by = c("USUBJID", "DOMAIN", "RULE_ID"))

Arguments

old_flags

Previous flags data.frame.

new_flags

Current flags data.frame.

by

Key columns used to identify the same flag record across cuts.

Value

A list with introduced, resolved, and persisting data.frame elements.

Examples

old_flags <- data.frame(
  USUBJID = c("A", "B"), DOMAIN = c("ADVS", "ADVS"), RULE_ID = c("R1", "R1")
)
new_flags <- data.frame(
  USUBJID = c("B", "C"), DOMAIN = c("ADVS", "ADVS"), RULE_ID = c("R1", "R1")
)
diff_flags(old_flags, new_flags)
#> $introduced
#>   USUBJID DOMAIN RULE_ID
#> 2       C   ADVS      R1
#> 
#> $resolved
#>   USUBJID DOMAIN RULE_ID
#> 1       A   ADVS      R1
#> 
#> $persisting
#>   USUBJID DOMAIN RULE_ID
#> 1       B   ADVS      R1
#>
